notes.title: A Massive Free Update is Available Now for Beyond Blue!
notes.notes:
Get ready to dive back into the world of Beyond Blue, as a new update is now available for the game on PC! This update will bring tons of new, free content to Beyond Blue, so first-time swimmers and veteran divers alike will want to "sea" what we’ve been up to.

[previewyoutube=2HZ5-2jok5Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Make a Splash in a New Region - The Tropical Reef![/h2]
This update introduces a brand new dive region for players to explore, the Tropical Reef. Swim among the coral and plant life, navigate underwater caverns, and check in on the underwater research base in the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987313/7b1d5ea74cac91c28a34af37a170039c9d0b3848.jpg[/img]

It’s not all about the scenic sights down here - The Tropical Reef is also home to some new creatures to discover! The Zebra Shark, Ocellated Eagle Ray, and many more call this reef their home, on top of the large number of creatures already in the game. They help bring the Tropical Reef to life, while also providing Mirai with some obstacles to avoid while she’s completing Activities.

[h2]Test Your Swimming Skills with Activities![/h2]
Beyond Blue has always provided an engrossing narrative combined with exploration-based gameplay, but for those looking for something a bit more action-packed, Daily Activities are here to liven up your dives. Every day, a new Activity will be made available for you to check out from the Main Menu. These Activities can take place in any of the dive locations, including the brand-new Tropical Reef, and will test your proficiency in one of three challenges:[list]
[*] [b]Point-to-Point Race[/b] - Swim through waypoints and race to the goal. Be "shore" to watch out for any sea life that might try to swim right into your path!
[*] [b]Scavenger Hunt[/b] - Search the designated zone for buried treasure… or at least a power-up or two that might help you on your way!
[*] [b]Relay[/b] - Race across the map and try to return as many items to the treasure chest as you can within the time limit! Keep an eye out for some useful power-ups, too![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987313/00b507fb998449f4e0a0e4df9913922a3d0a790f.jpg[/img]

To help you do your best in these new Activities, Mirai has a tweaked moveset only available in Activity Mode: If you repeatedly tap the Fast Swim button with the right timing, you can keep going faster and faster! But watch out - hitting something in this state will leave you stunned. Depending on your performance in an activity, you will receive a Bronze, Silver, or Gold Medal, along with a reward of Sand Dollars! What purpose do those Sand Dollars serve, you may ask?

[h2]Swim in Style with New Suits![/h2]
You can use the Sand Dollars you earn from Activities to purchase new suits in the Dive Shop! As you complete in-game challenges, you’ll unlock the ability to purchase more and more suits. Suits can be equipped from the Main Menu or the Pause Menu at any time - even in Story Mode and Photo Mode - so feel free to experiment and see which looks you like best! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987313/ab0f5e444b63d43040fc53d192f596729b13ac95.jpg[/img]

[h2]Take in the Views with Dive-In Theater![/h2]
Beyond Blue is a beautiful game, and sometimes that makes you just want to kick back and watch the world pass you by. We have you covered! Dive-In Theater is a laid-back experience where the camera automatically moves through Beyond Blue’s many environments and passes by its plethora of creatures. Leave it running as pleasant background noise while you work on other things, or watch along, basking in the beauty of the ocean. You’ll even unlock a few new suits in the process!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987313/95a26793636eff42541e8e48b70f9f9881ea0c42.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new content, this update includes the following fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue that was causing the first load screen to freeze for some players
[*] Fixed issue that was causing the Continue option from the main menu to not work correctly
[*] Fixed issue that caused certain languages to not display correctly
[*] Added the ability to rebind keyboard inputs
[*] Fixed issue where certain music still triggered detection on Twitch with Creator Mode enabled
[*] Fixed issue preventing Ocean Insights from playing on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed issue affecting the Continue button on Main Menu on Steam Deck
[/list]

With all these new features, there are more ways to enjoy the world of Beyond Blue than ever before, so what are you waiting for? Your support makes updates like this possible, so thank you and we’ll see you in the water!

notes.title: Photo Mode Is Here! 1.4 Patch Notes and More
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=i6Bec4JL5zo;full][/previewyoutube]

Without a doubt, our most-requested feature for Beyond Blue is Photo Mode. Well, today we're excited to announce that it's available in the free 1.4 update right now! To access Photo Mode, hit F1 on your keyboard or Left on your controller’s D-Pad. We’re also running a Photo Mode contest to celebrate the occasion (details below).

We can't wait to see the photos you're going to create!

~ The Beyond Blue Team

Here's the complete list of features and fixes we've included in 1.4:[list]
[*] Photo Mode (community request)
[*] Depth Meter on HUD (community request)
[*] Invert X and Y-Axis (community request)
[*] Auto-save indicator
[*] Quality of life updates to UI
[*] Minor bug fixes [/list]
--
[b]Beyond Blue's Photo Mode Contest[/b]
One (1) winner will receive a limited edition Beyond Blue desktop artwork from Artovision

[b]TO ENTER:[/b] Share your Photo Mode screenshot on Twitter or Instagram using hashtag #BeyondBluePhotoMode and follow @BeyondBlueGame

[b]CRITERIA:[/b] Entries will be judged based on creativity, originality, and usage of the Photo Mode tools

[b]ENTRY PERIOD:[/b] Entries open October 20th @ 10am PT and close November 3rd @ 10am PT
[i]
Must be 18+ to participate. Potential winners will be contacted by direct message on Twitter/Instagram and may be required to verify ownership of their submission. Winner will be announced on November 10th.
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987313/8f5e2a992df9aaff18d00f3eb4af8846a072b5a0.png[/img]

notes.title: 6/18 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Today we've released an update with the following fixes and features:
[list]
[*] [b]Streamer Mode[/b] - Creators can now disable licensed music in the game and replace it with original score. You can enable this feature through the Creators section of the Pause menu. Read more about this feature on the Creators page on our official website: http://beyondbluegame.com/creators
[*] [b]Button Map[/b] - You can now view a button map for keyboard and controllers under Controller settings in the Pause menu.
[*] [b]Expanded Audio Controls[/b] - We broke out audio controls into more channels to allow you to fine-tune your experience.
[*] [b]Bug fixes [/b]- Thanks for reporting bugs, keep them coming!
[/list]
We would also like to take a moment to say that we are humbled and grateful for the overwhelming response to Beyond Blue. From the bottom of our hearts... thank youuuuuuuu!

~ The Beyond Blue Team

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer + Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=DwRYx18ORN0;full][/previewyoutube]

Big news: Beyond Blue will be arriving on Steam during World Oceans Week which kicks off June 8th!

We also just premiered a brand new Gameplay Trailer. It features never-before-seen footage and a deep dive (ha!) into Beyond Blue's gameplay.

June will be here before you know it and we appreciate your patience as we put the final touches on the game. We know you're going to love it!

~The Beyond Blue Team

notes.title: An Update About Beyond Blue
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32987313/b790b6393daab2433588111bc85ea8ac0f9539db.png[/img]

Our goal with Beyond Blue has always been to create a game that truly captures the wonder of the ocean and the mysteries it holds. 

To ensure we deliver the best experience possible, we’ve made the difficult decision to push the launch of Beyond Blue by a few months to February 2020. We’re confident the game will be worth the wait.

We appreciate your support and enthusiasm for the work we’re doing and can’t wait to share it with you very soon.

~ The Beyond Blue Team
